newsitem.title: USA: GeoTel files patent suit against Genesys.
newsitem.headline: GeoTel files patent suit against Genesys.

text.p: GeoTel Communications Corp said Friday it has filed a patent infringement suit against Genesys Telecommunications Laboratories Inc in U.S. District Court in Massachusetts.
GeoTel said the suit seeks damages and injunctive relief, alleging that Genesys' call router product infringes on a GeoTel software patent.

"This patent serves as a foundation of GeoTel's unique class of software offerings, and represents a strategic company asset," stated John C. Thibault, chief executive of Geotel. "As such, we are committed to defending its exclusive rights against any third-party infringements."

GeoTel's Intelligent CallRouter software (ICR) is an enterprise-wide, intelligent call routing system that links multiple, geographically dispersed call centers. Through its ability to provide call-by-call routing to distributed agent groups across different ACD platforms and 800 number providers, the ICR creates a virtual call center network.
GeoTel said this is the only enterprise- wide call distribution system to meet the certification standards of AT&T Corp Corp, MCI Communications Corp and Sprint Corp.
